name: Dreame
headline: Dreame: private ownership, Xiaomi investment history and product expansion
description: Dreame is a privately held technology business founded by Yu Hao. Its documented Xiaomi and Shunwei investment history does not establish Xiaomi as its parent. The portfolio extends from robot vacuums and floor washers to lawn, pool, window-cleaning and other home categories in selected markets.
metaDescription: Dreame company profile: Yu Hao, Xiaomi investment history, manufacturing, 2026 Aqua20 and robotic mower expansion, and regional product availability.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Dreame, MOVA or Xiaomi. Dreame is privately held, and historical financing announcements do not establish a complete current cap table.
founded: Official pages conflict: Dreame's global Brand Story says the company was established in 2015, while its US and Korean About pages say 2017.

ownership.summary: Dreame is a privately held company founded and led by Yu Hao. A 2020 company financing announcement identified Xiaomi Corporation and Shunwei Capital as returning shareholders and said Dreame had joined the Xiaomi ecosystem in 2017; it did not identify Xiaomi as parent or controller. The current complete ownership and voting structure is not publicly disclosed. MOVA is a separate consumer brand described on its regional site as powered by Dreame Technology, but its products, apps and contracting entities should not be treated as interchangeable with Dreame.

productPortfolio.name: Robot vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: A premium core built around navigation, mopping and multifunction docks. Dreame’s German IFA 2026 page highlights the Aqua20 Pro Ultra Roller X Complete.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Forms the premium core of a Dreame assortment and its dock-based service proposition.

productPortfolio.name: Wet-and-dry floor cleaners
productPortfolio.positioning: Upright hard-floor cleaning systems spanning mainstream and premium models.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Supports tiered hard-floor assortments across mainstream and premium price points.

productPortfolio.name: Cordless stick vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: The high-speed-motor category that helped establish Dreame's independent brand.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Adds a dry-floorcare line tied to Dreame's core motor platform.

productPortfolio.name: Home, yard and personal-care products
productPortfolio.positioning: A regional portfolio spanning hair care, air care, kitchen appliances, robotic lawn mowers, pool cleaners and window-cleaning robots. The IFA 2026 display includes the A4 AWD Pro mower series.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Requires market-specific assortment checks because adjacent categories are available only in selected markets.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Dreame's official brand history says it operates three production lines with annual throughput of one million units and can accept multi-category ODM orders.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm whether the contracted product is Dreame-branded production or an ODM order and identify its manufacturer.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The official contact page identifies a Dreame factory and headquarters site on Wuzhong Boulevard in Suzhou. A separate official Korean profile describes a 33,150-square-metre intelligent factory using manufacturing execution systems and automated robot-vacuum assembly.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify whether the exact SKU is assembled at the named Suzhou facility.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Manufacturer-of-record can vary by category and model. Buyers should verify the product label and compliance documents rather than assume every Dreame-branded product is made by the same legal entity.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify the manufacturer on the product label and compliance documents for the exact model.

marketsChannels.evidence: Dreame's current US company page says the brand reaches more than 120 countries and regions and operates more than 4,000 physical stores, alongside ecommerce and dealer channels.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the authorized ecommerce, dealer and physical-store route in the target market.

marketsChannels.evidence: The global contact page lists localized support across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Latin America and provides a dedicated distribution contact.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the local support entity and distribution agreement for the target region.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Dreame combines a fast-widening portfolio—from robot and upright floorcare into yard, pool, personal-care and home appliances—with ecommerce, distributors and a growing physical-store network. Its Xiaomi ecosystem history accelerated the early business but does not define current legal ownership. The strategic pressure is organizational: Dreame must convert rapid category launches and high marketing intensity into durable service, quality and channel economics while Roborock and Ecovacs contest the same premium floorcare and offline experience space.

developments.summary: Dreame’s German IFA 2026 page features Aqua20 Pro Ultra Roller X Complete and the A4 AWD Pro mower series. The display shows cross-category expansion; launch timing and range differ by country.
